headline: Administrative Aide

notes: Internship with a regional development authority's planning office

summary: Public administration graduate with Civil Service eligibility and a year as an administrative aide in a regional development authority. I process public requests, keep official records and archives in order, and help prepare policy briefs and memoranda. I want to build a career in local governance.

projects.name: Records digitisation
projects.description: Scanned, indexed and catalogued 12 years of board resolutions so staff can find any resolution in minutes.

projects.name: Ati-Atihan visitor services study
bullets: Surveyed 300 festival visitors on public services during the Ati-Atihan season.
Recommended a single visitor help desk, presented to the local tourism council.

skills: Government service support and frontline assistance
Policy support: briefs, memoranda and research

experience.title: Administrative Aide
bullets: Receive and route about 40 public requests and permits a day through the tracking log.
Maintain board resolutions, contracts and correspondence in the records room and digital archive.
Prepare background notes and draft memoranda for the planning division.
Update the office's Excel trackers for pending requests and deadlines.

experience.title: Planning Office Intern
bullets: Encoded project data and helped prepare the annual investment plan tables.
